goal: Production Feature Materialization for J-Quants Research Studio. Finish the connection between already-implemented research logic and production-grade, decision-useful datasets before adding any new data category. The current priority is not breadth; it is to materialize, backfill, validate, expose, and operationalize the existing forward-return, benchmark-relative return, shareholder-benefit, and total-yield capabilities. First, design and implement a dedicated production outcome/read-model contract for 1/5/20/60-trading-day forward returns and benchmark-relative excess returns using already-stored jq_market_price_daily history. Treat these values explicitly as ex-post outcomes for hypothesis validation, not point-in-time features available on the observation date; keep them structurally separated from contemporaneous PIT features and add tests/audits that prevent look-ahead leakage. Compute from stored data first with zero external provider calls, preserve adjusted-price semantics, align benchmark/security sessions deterministically, leave horizon-tail values null until sufficient future sessions exist, and make the materialization idempotent, incremental, resumable, and safe to rerun. Add the required Supabase schema/migrations and bounded materialization path, with indexes/keys/provenance sufficient for research joins without duplicating provider data. Second, connect the already-implemented shareholder-benefit normalization and dividend_yield total-yield logic to the production jq_market_yield publication/backfill path so that investable capital, annual monetary benefit value, benefit yield, and dividend-plus-benefit total yield become populated where source evidence supports them. Reuse existing stored/source facts and existing provider feeds; do not introduce broad new scraping or new peripheral APIs merely to increase field counts. Preserve missing/unknown states rather than inventing values, and retain source provenance. Third, expose the materialized outcomes and total-yield fields through the existing Research Workspace/API/metric catalog/search/compare surfaces only where this improves investment research, with clear labeling that forward/excess returns are historical outcome metrics rather than investable-at-time-t inputs. Fourth, add production-oriented coverage/null/staleness/PIT-leakage validation and data-status reporting so we can verify materialized row coverage, horizon completeness, benchmark alignment, benefit normalization coverage, and safe null behavior. Existing earnings-detail PENDING work should continue under the current quota-aware EDINET/J-Quants controls; do not raise provider limits, remove request reserves, or create unbounded per-security fetching. Preserve all existing safety properties: quota safeguards, fail-closed limits, idempotency, resumability, atomic/staged publication where already used, security lifecycle semantics, and repository CI. Prefer migrations and code reviewed through the normal ADE PR/CI path rather than ad-hoc production mutation. Success means: forward-return and benchmark-excess outcome data are actually materializable from stored production price history; the production path can backfill and incrementally refresh them; benefit/total-yield fields are populated when evidence exists; Workspace/API can consume the results safely; automated tests and audits demonstrate no PIT leakage; and the research system can directly test whether earnings/valuation/yield signals were followed by future excess returns without adding unnecessary data categories.
